# Selection orders and their casualties

`customer_support.df.queue_management.selection_orders_and_their_casualties` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Three defensible selection orders, each with a named casualty — first-in-first-out is fair and slow, shortest-job-first maximises throughput and abandons the hard cases, severity-first serves the worst break and requires an honest severity.

There is no order without a victim. Choosing consciously means knowing who you have decided to disappoint; choosing unconsciously means being surprised by them later, at volume, in an escalation.
